children: Raspberry Pi's expansion into semiconductor sales is a potential driver of longer-term revenue growth and margin expansion, Jefferies analysts write. The low-cost computer maker's strength as a supplier of single-board computers will also help increase profitability and market share, they add. Jefferies has a buy rating on the stock and a 960 pence target price. Shares are up 14% at 717.50 pence, leading the FTSE 250 index risers. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
